_about: Switches that are not in the tree YET (the EP, 2026-10-31, Orb's night order). A row with no `file` is a name waiting for its key: tools/preview/preview.mjs lists it as WAITING in --list, --check and every build, and never counts it as passed. When its owner lands the key, add `file`, `path` (an array of keys), `from` and `to` (the value without and with it) and optionally `needs` (ids) and `what`; the row then behaves as a switch: on by default, `--off <id>`, checked by --check (a key that holds neither value is an error), and read back by the smoke check only if you also give it a `probe` line (see the table in switches.mjs). A row whose file is in the tree but whose key is not stays waiting. Nothing here is a guess about a key: no file, no flip.
